'''Earth Surge''' is an [[Earth spells|earth]]-based [[Surge spells|surge spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 90 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest earth spell in the game.

==Damage ==
Earth Surge has a base maximum hit of 23 which increases to 24 when the player unlocks [[Fire Surge]] at level 95 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Earth Surge's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an earth-based spell, Earth Surge's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to earth]].
